new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors Reports Q2 2026 Earnings Beat with Record Results
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported second-quarter profit of $170.5 million, or $3.22 per share, beating analyst estimates. The company posted revenue of $1.74 billion, topping analyst forecasts of $1.62 billion. The Environmental Services segment benefited from disposal and recycling volumes and PFAS work, while the Safety-Kleen segment saw higher market pricing for re-refined products.

new_today_news.headline: Liquid Waste Management Solution Market Forecast 2026-2032: Environmental Compliance and Waste Treatment Demand Drives Growth
new_today_news.summary: The global liquid waste management solutions market was valued at $3.087 billion in 2025 and is anticipated to reach $5.251 billion by 2032, with 8.0% CAGR, driven by environmental compliance and waste treatment demand.

recent_news.headline: RestaurantData Estimates 8,171 Restaurant Closures in First Half of 2026
recent_news.summary: An estimated 8,171 restaurant locations closed across the United States and Canada during the first half of 2026, with closures divided almost evenly between chain-affiliated (52.1%) and independent restaurants (47.9%). Recently established restaurants that opened between 2024 and 2026 represented 39.9% of closures.

recent_news.headline: Restaurant Data July 2026 Opening Report - Small Chain Expansion Trends
recent_news.summary: Four restaurant companies crossed operating thresholds between November 2025 and June 2026, including Slice House (expanding from 29 to 36 units), Juiceland (28 to 34 units), Walk-On's Sports Bistreaux (68 to 73 units), and Guthrie's Chicken Fingers (70 to 73 units).

recent_news.headline: Xylem Inc. Enters Definitive Agreement to Acquire WaterFleet
recent_news.summary: Xylem entered into a definitive agreement on July 24, 2026, to acquire 100% of WaterFleet Intermediate Holdings, Inc., a company specializing in mobile water and wastewater utility services and workforce relief solutions, for approximately $200 million. The acquisition is expected to close in 2026 and will be included in the Water Solutions and Services segment.

recent_news.headline: Water treatment infrastructure projects continue expansion with billions in IIJA funding allocation through FY2026
recent_news.summary: EPA announced $7.2 billion in FY2026 water infrastructure funding. The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act provided over $50 billion for drinking water, wastewater, and stormwater infrastructure. Multiple state legislatures continue allocating funding for modernization projects.

backfill_news.headline: Waste to Energy Program Launches 2026 Technical Assistance Initiative
backfill_news.summary: DOE launched its 2026 Waste to Energy and Materials Technical Assistance Program for state, local, and Tribal governments. The program provides no-cost technical assistance to help evaluate waste-to-energy end uses, including on-site heat and power, transportation fuels, and material recovery. The expanded program now includes industrial wastewater.
